title: How AI Created the Fastest Product Cycle in History

reader_summary.headline: Nisha Charya is A16Z's general partner for consumer tech and AI.
reader_summary.overview: Nisha Charya is A16Z's general partner for consumer tech and AI. He recently joined Ali Forsythe on new economies for a wide-ranging conversation on where the next wave of breakout products will come from. They also dig into founder psychology, market timing, and the traps early builders should avoid in the current cycle.

thesis: The podcast argues that the current AI landscape represents the fastest product cycle in history due to the massive scale of the tech sector and the shift from being the 'dog chasing the car' to being the 'car' itself. It further contends that this acceleration is driven by the enormous audience available through new AI app stores, such as the upcoming ChatGPT release, which offers 850 million potential customers compared to the six million iPhone users available when the original app store launched in 2009.
